title: CD wrong fixes: single-satellite carrier ramps inside FIX streaks; post-fix max residual telemetry
reference_use: labels and truth-geometry DD (analysis only); never a solver input
solver_behaviour: unchanged; two debug-epoch-log columns appended (postfix_residual_max_abs_m, postfix_residual_max_pair); default and CD POS byte-identical before/after on Trimble Odaiba and Shinjuku

episodes.truth_dd_culprit: G25 L1C -1.45 cycle over 2.3 s (one LLI)
episodes.postfix_max_pair: G12-G25 from 0.10 m error on, 0.025-0.052 m
G12-G24 once (0.021 m); then hold fixes (no post-fix residual)
E09-E05 early (0.018-0.025 m), then spreads to E31/E24 (up to 0.060 m)
C24-C09 / C06-C09 (0.03-0.04 m) before hold fixes

Shinjuku.example: E09-E05/L2 40.68 m (about 160 E5a cycles) for 6 s from TOW 282806 with 4 cm position error; truth DD of E05 E5a drifts 3 cycles in 22 s after an LLI at 282788

grossly_wrong_integer_in_correct_fixes.consequence: such fixes have postfix RMS of metres, so the opt-in max_postfix_residual_rms check would reject correct fixes; whether these integers are later held is not yet checked

verdict: mechanism identified; no rule proposed: the culprit pair is visible early in 3 of 5 episodes, but at 2-5 cm it is inside the correct-fix p95, so a magnitude threshold cannot separate; a persistence test would need its own frozen evaluation
